extracted.name: Italian Dressing Mix
extracted.description: This Italian salad dressing recipe combines 10 aromatic herbs and spices that can be stored and used to whip up fresh Italian dressing in seconds.
instruction_lines: Mix together oregano, salt, parsley, garlic salt, onion powder, sugar, pepper, basil, thyme, and celery salt in a bowl. Store in a tightly sealed container until ready to use.
